name: Hold My Pistaches
detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in a world of magic and tactics with Hold My Pistaches, a unique dynamic card game where the greatest magicians fight to be crowned the best. In this world, every card is a new spell, every move is a new strategic maneuver, and every victory is proof of your power and skill.

Use your spell deck to control the forces of nature and destroy your enemies. Use cunning tactics and react to your opponents' moves to win intense duels.

- Multiplayer battles
Fight against players from all over the world in real time. Take part in ranked matches or simply enjoy friendly duels.

- Collecting and customization

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100T or AMD FX 6100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 740 or Radeon HD 5770
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3570K or AMD Ryzen 3 1300x
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 460 or Radeon HD 7770
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
